title: Bringing The Kingdom To The Workplace Part 2
paragraphs: Or the Hindus. Or those whose skin color is different from yours. Or those people who live on the streets. Or that woman you saw on your city street last night. You, the addict who wanders aimlessly. Are you sure you know who it is? Perhaps it is those kind, clean people you encounter who do not offend you much. These are the people you believe God loves. God loves everyone. Whoever believes in that must do so. This verse also tells us about the purpose of sending Jesus.

God's purpose in sending Jesus into the world was for the world to believe in Jesus. God wants the world to believe in Him, and that is a difficult task. In order to believe, one needs evidence, and also needs to have a desire created within oneself, and to feel the benefit. In other words, I believe in this because it will benefit me. Faith is a very complicated matter. To believe in someone, you must have concrete evidence; you must provide information. God's ultimate goal is for everyone to have eternal life.

What a great sign! Everything is in it. Now, for God so loved the world that he sent his Son. The Son came into the world because God sent him. The Son came into the world, but did not remain in it, for he came to love the world, or to show God’s love for him. To show God's love for the world, God made a plan for it. The aim of the program was to create a group of people who would do this for God. Let me explain it another way.

God loved the world so much that He sent His Son to create a mechanism that would make the world feel, know, or believe in love. It is not Jesus who loves the world, but he is the proof that God sent into the world so that the world would know that he loves Him. The evidence came to show further evidence, so that the world would know that God loves him. What did this son create to make the world know that God loves him?

He created a group of people from among the world so that the world would know that God loves him. This group was called the Church. In fact, they are not called the church, but the group is called the church. Do you understand what I mean? So, what God actually did was send his Son, and his Son sent the Church. I want you to understand this now. Therefore, the goal of the church is to prove that God loves the world, and that we should love the world for God's sake. We are not doing well. I will repeat it.

The goal of the church is to make the world love God and to demonstrate God's love for it. But in this entity called the Church, we believe that our goal is to go to Heaven. To leave the earth, to renounce the world, to hate sinners, to avoid them, to distance ourselves from them, to despise them, to condemn them, to rebuke them, to treat them with contempt, to stay away from them. We are doing the opposite of everything God wants us to do for the world. In fact, we hate the world that God loves.

Do you know that we show the world the opposite of what God wants to show? What does God want to show the world? His love. What does the church do? We love ourselves. Church rituals are like a self-pity party where we pretend to enjoy ourselves. We spend more time complaining about what God is not doing for us in church rituals than doing what He has commanded us to do. So, we need to rearrange our thoughts, stop what we are doing, step back a little, and see if we can get our mission back on track.

What is our mission? Go out into the whole world. Look at this. God loves the world, so what did He do? He sent his only son. His son loved the world, so what did he do? He sent his only church. Do you see that? God sent his Son, and the Son sent the Church. God sent his Son into the world, and the Son sent the world into the Church, to bring the Church into the world. Therefore, the church is supposed to be God's proof of his love for the world. Well, look at the Gospel of John, chapter three, verse 17.

The other verse. Why, after Jesus told us how much God loves the world in verse 16, does he rush to tell us what we shouldn't do to the world? Let's read it. "For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world." Now, that is exactly what the church does. I mean, he is quick to provide this important correction or warning. What a god! God did not send his son into the world to condemn the world. Why? Because God loves the world. How can you condemn something you love?

You are either schizophrenic, insane, or mentally disturbed. I love you, and that's why I hate you. I mean, that's how things are. I love you, but you're useless. I love you, but you don't deserve it. Are you confused? God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him. Then he came and founded this body called the Church, and became its head. Who is he to save the world? This body with its head. Christ is called the head of the Church, which is his body.

To save the world through him. This means that the world is supposed to be saved not through the head, but through the body. The church. That's why they left. Hallelujah. So, how are things going at your workplace? Why don't people like you? Why do they run away when she appears? Oh my God, here come those crazy Christians again. Let's go. Here he comes again with all these myths about Jesus. Let's leave. That's exactly what they say about you at work. Your family scatters when you visit them. Come on, talk to me.

Something is wrong. Tell me, why don't they love you when they loved Jesus? Are you supposed to love them for his sake? Did you know that it is amazing that God loved the world so much that He sent? His only son. And what did the son do? He made the world love him. How did he do that? By showing them his love. I mean, the prostitutes loved this man. The children loved him. The rich loved him. The poor loved him. Women loved him. Men loved him. He was loved by alcoholics. Tax collectors loved him.

The Roman soldiers loved him. Everyone loved him. Why do they hate you? Because you're not doing anything right. You don't know how to love the world. In fact, religion, specifically Christianity, has taught you that the world should be hated. That's why God is no longer here. We don't like the world. Be honest. What did they teach you in Sunday school, in church, in Bible study? What did they teach you?

Do not touch, do not feel, do not taste, rise above them, be separate, be distinct, which in reality means superior. I mean, I remember when you were my friend. What has happened since you became a Christian? You used to come to visit me all the time. What happened? Am I being sarcastic now? How strange. We don't know how to love the world. The 21st century church must change. Let me make a few statements about the church. Firstly, the church does not exist for the sake of heaven.

Secondly, God does not want the church in heaven. Prove me wrong. Read your Bible and prove me wrong. Tell me if I'm wrong. I challenge you to tell me if I'm wrong. Find a verse from the Bible and tell me if I'm wrong. If God had wanted you to go to heaven, He would have killed you a long time ago. It's the fastest way to get there. Third, the church exists for the world. Fourth, the church exists for the nation. Fifth, the church is charged with serving the nation.

Go into all the world and make disciples of all nations. This is the task. Therefore, the church is subordinate to the nation. But we hate the nation. We despise the nation. We condemn the nation. We wish the nation would go to hell. literally. Why? After all, we are upright, we are saved, our children are saved, our husbands are saved, our wives are saved, our dogs are saved, even our cats are blessed. We are ready to go to heaven. God forbid. The mission of the Church is to reconcile the world with God.

Jesus said, Matthew 28:18: “Go into all the world and make disciples of all nations.” Then he baptized them with the authority of God, that is, in His name. Restore God's authority to them. Please write down this phrase. It is the most profound statement that can be said to you. Here's the phrase: Sinners are not enemies of God. Wow! We are all born sinners. Write this phrase down. From your behavior, of course, you don't believe that. Every sinner is a son of God. How much has God brainwashed you with this idea! Every sinner is a son of God.
